tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: The brand orange (from the landing page). Fills only: the primary oval button, my chat bubbles, the brand oval, unread counts, active nav. Never as small text on light grounds (2.7:1 on ground); use ember-ink for orange text.

tokens.name: ember-light
tokens.usage: Highlight end of the feature-art gradient and decorative ovals. Decoration only, never text or borders that carry meaning.

tokens.name: ember-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for ember buttons; focus ring (3.8:1 on ground, 3.4:1 on surface); end of the feature-art gradient.

tokens.name: ember-wash
tokens.usage: Soft brand ground: reward chips, soft buttons, selected list rows, hover on line buttons.

tokens.name: ember-ink
tokens.usage: ADDED for accessibility. Orange text and links on ground, surface and ember-wash (5.3:1 / 4.8:1 / 4.7:1 light; 9:1 dark). Eyebrows, inline links, active tab labels, the label under a primary oval button.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Icons, initials and short numbers on an ember fill. Light theme keeps the landing page's white (2.7:1 on ember, just under the 3:1 for icons; source pair kept for the brand), so icons on ember use a 2px stroke and 20px+ size. Dark theme uses near-black (8.2:1). Button labels sit below the oval in ink, not on ember.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on ground, surface, sunken and ember-wash (15:1+ light, 15:1+ dark).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, timestamps, helper text, inactive nav labels. On ground and surface (5.3:1+ light, 8.1:1+ dark).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels only (2.8:1 light, below AA by design). Never for text a person must read.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Light is pure white, as on the landing page.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Banded sections, side panels, the chat list pane, input fills.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Their chat bubbles, pressed rows, skeleton blocks, tracks.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, menus and popovers that sit above ground or surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders: cards, dividers, list separators. Decorative, not for form controls.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: text inputs, checkboxes (3:1 on ground).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Points, streak flames, the BTCY coin glow. Fill and decoration only (2.2:1 as text on white).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Brand lime. Success fills: online presence dot, check-in done, accept call, done steps. Content on it uses on-success (dark ink), never white (1.4:1).

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on ground and success-wash: a darker shade of the lime so it stays readable (5.3:1 light). Dark theme uses the lime itself.

tokens.name: success-wash
tokens.usage: Success banner and tag background.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Icons and text on a success (lime) fill (14:1).

tokens.name: success-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for success (lime) fills and buttons.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on ground and warning-wash. ADDED for text.

tokens.name: warning-wash
tokens.usage: Warning banner and tag background.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive fills: delete buttons, end-call. Labels on it use on-status at 15px/700.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error text, field error messages, destructive text buttons (5.4:1 light, 6.3:1 dark). ADDED for text.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Text and icons on success and danger fills (4.2:1 on danger light, 5.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: Error banner and tag background.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons; info tags (4.5:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: info-wash
tokens.usage: Info banner background.

tokens.name: notify
tokens.usage: Unread notification dot only, a small pip with no text in it.

tokens.name: bubble-me
tokens.usage: My chat bubble fill; text in it uses on-ember.

tokens.name: bubble-them
tokens.usage: Their chat bubble fill; text in it uses ink.

tokens.name: pill-bg
tokens.usage: App Store and Google Play badge fill.

tokens.name: pill-ink
tokens.usage: Text and logo on the store badge.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals and sheets.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Section headings on marketing pages. Fluid: clamp(34px, 4.3vw, 54px).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Page titles in the app on desktop; legal page headings.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles in the app header; card titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a screen; sheet titles.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Oval button labels, set below the oval in ink (14px/18px at lg and xl).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a heading, in ember-ink.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Message friends, join communities and earn IndexxPoints every day.
styles.usage: Hero and section intros. Fluid: clamp(17px, 1.7vw, 20px).

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Earning is part of chatting, not a separate app.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: See you at 8 — I'll bring the tickets.
styles.usage: App body text, chat messages, list titles.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names in lists, emphasis in app text.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Bubble timestamps, badge counts, tab bar labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips; tick marks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; bubble stack gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row vertical padding; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default padding: cards on phone, screen gutters on phone.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between oval buttons in a row; gap between cards in a rail.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; screen gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target; large section gaps in the app.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing section spacing on phone.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Marketing section spacing on desktop (the old page used 170px; 96 keeps the rhythm with less scrolling).

tokens.name: radius-tail
tokens.usage: The tail corner of a chat bubble (bottom-left for theirs, bottom-right for mine).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, small tiles, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-store
tokens.usage: App Store / Google Play badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text inputs, toasts, banners.

tokens.name: radius-bubble
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, feature cards, sheets (top corners).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, the search bar and segmented tabs. Never buttons: every button is an OvalButton.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Store badges, menus, the selected tab.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, popovers, sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-hero
tokens.usage: The hero phone and modal dialogs only.

size.note: Fixed sizes for the brand oval and the app shell.

tokens.name: oval-xs
tokens.usage: Count badges and status pips (width).

tokens.name: oval-sm
tokens.usage: Small oval buttons inside dense rows; avatars in dense lists.

tokens.name: oval-md
tokens.usage: Default oval button (header, composer, cards); avatars in chat headers.

tokens.name: oval-lg
tokens.usage: The main action of a screen or sheet; quick-action grids; avatars in the chat list.

tokens.name: oval-xl
tokens.usage: Hero actions on marketing pages and the floating new-chat action; profile avatar.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of text inputs, and the minimum touch area around every control.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: App header and marketing nav height.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Desktop navigation rail width.

tokens.name: list-w
tokens.usage: Desktop list pane width (chat list, community list).

oval.note: The brand oval: one hand-drawn ellipse, measured from assets/Brand/oval.png.

tokens.name: oval-aspect
tokens.usage: aspect-ratio of every oval box, so the ellipse fills it edge to edge.

tokens.name: oval-tilt
tokens.usage: The ellipse's rotation inside that box. Never change it.
